description: This file 'text_utils.c' contains various utility functions for string manipulation, data parsing, and conversion, specifically tailored for processing text, path schemas, encoding/decoding, and conversions between string representations and internal data types in a software project.

methods.name: dm_hash_t TEXT_UTILS_CalcHash(char * s)
methods.description: Calculates a 32-bit FNV1a hash of a string.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToUnsigned(char * str,unsigned * value)
methods.description: Converts a string to an unsigned integer with range check.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToInteger(char * str,int * value)
methods.description: Converts a string to a signed integer.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToUnsignedLongLong(char * str,unsigned long long * value)
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit unsigned long long.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToLongLong(char * str,long long * value)
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit signed long long.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToDouble(char * str,double * value)
methods.description: Converts a string to a double.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToBool(char * str,bool * value)
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_BoolToString(bool value)
methods.description: Converts a boolean to string 'true' or 'false'.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToEnum(char * str,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Converts a string to an enumeration value based on a lookup table.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_EnumToString(int value,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Converts an enumeration integer value to its string representation.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_EnumListToString(const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums,char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Converts a list of enum values to a comma-separated string.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToDateTime(char * str,time_t * value)
methods.description: Converts an ISO8601 string to time_t.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToBinary(char * str,unsigned char * buf,int len,int * bytes_written)
methods.description: Converts a hex ASCII string to binary data.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_Base64StringToBinary(char * str,unsigned char * buf,int len,int * bytes_written)
methods.description: Converts a Base64 encoded string to binary data.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToIpAddr(char * str,nu_ipaddr_t * ip_addr)
methods.description: Converts string to IP address (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_ListToString(char ** items,int num_items,char * buf,int len,char * separator)
methods.description: Creates a comma-separated string from an array of strings.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_SplitString(char * str,str_vector_t * sv,char * separator)
methods.description: Splits a string into substrings based on a separator, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_StrncpyLen(char * dst,int dst_len,char * src,int src_len)
methods.description: Copies string with specified length, ensuring null termination.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_StrStr(char * haystack,char * needle)
methods.description: Finds a substring 'needle' in 'haystack', ignoring quotes.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringTailCmp(char * haystack,char * needle)
methods.description: Checks if the end of haystack matches needle.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_SplitPath(char * path,char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Splits a path into object path and parameter name.

methods.name: bool TEXT_UTILS_IsPathMatch(char * path,char * path_spec)
methods.description: Checks whether a data model path matches a path spec, considering wildcards.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_KeyValueFromString(char * buf,char ** key,char ** value)
methods.description: Parses a key-value pair from a line buffer, modifies the buffer.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_NullStringCompare(char * str1,char * str2)
methods.description: Compares two strings, considering NULL as equal.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_TrimBuffer(char * buf)
methods.description: Trims leading/trailing whitespace in a string buffer.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_TrimDelimitedBuffer(char * buf,char * delimiters)
methods.description: Trims whitespace and delimiters from buffer.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_StripChars(char * strip_chars,char * src,char * dest,int dest_len)
methods.description: Removes specified characters from a string.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_PercentEncodeString(char * src,char * dst,int dst_len,char * safe_chars,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Percent-encodes characters in a string.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_PercentDecodeString(char * buf)
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded characters.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_ReplaceCharInString(char * src,char match_char,char * replacement,char * dst,int dst_len)
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a character with a string.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_HexStringToValue(char * s)
methods.description: Converts hex string to integer value (up to 7 hex digits).

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_HexDigitToValue(char c)
methods.description: Converts a hex digit character to its numeric value.

methods.name: char TEXT_UTILS_ValueToHexDigit(int nibble,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Converts an integer nibble to a hex character.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_PathToSchemaForm(char * path,char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Converts instantiated data model path to schema form by replacing instance numbers with '{i}'.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_CountConsecutiveDigits(char * p)
methods.description: Counts number of consecutive digit characters starting at string pointer.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_StrDupWithTrailingDot(char * path)
methods.description: Duplicates a string and adds a trailing '.' if not present.

methods.name: int TEXT_UTILS_StringToFirstUnsigned(char * str,unsigned * value)
methods.description: Extracts the first number found in a string.

methods.name: char * TEXT_UTILS_SearchExpressionsToWildcards(char * src,char * dest,int len)
methods.description: Replaces search expression brackets with wildcards '*' in a path string.

methods.name: void TEXT_UTILS_SchemaFormToPath(char * schema_path,char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Replaces '{i}' in schema paths with '*' for wildcarded paths.
